# Clean fixture

The lineage benchmark dataset trains on pairs ending at GOA snapshot
v226 and evaluates against v230. Earlier studies used v160 through
v220 as training cutoffs and v229 as eval window.

Allowlist members appearing here: v160, v200, v210, v215, v220, v226,
v227, v229, v230. All nine snapshots in one paragraph.

No reranker shorthand appears in this file.
